NP024.label: The proposal methodology includes the following study objects/subjects

options.cec_samples: Individuals from whom biological samples will be collected (blood, tissue, secretions, etc.)
options.cec_drugs: Individuals who will receive drugs or on whom medical devices will be used
options.cec_surveys: Individuals who will participate in surveys, interviews, questionnaires, etc.
options.cec_records: Individuals from whom location records (GPS) or graphic and/or sound records (audio, video, photographs) will be collected
options.cec_vulnerable: Minors, people from Indigenous peoples, students, persons deprived of liberty, people with a disability requiring additional safeguards, or other persons requiring additional safeguards
options.cec_social: Manipulation of the social and/or cultural environment (e.g. ethnographic studies, urban interventions, etc.)
options.cecua_samples: Collection of biological samples from animals and/or anatomical parts derived from animals
options.cecua_prior: Previously obtained biological samples from animals and/or anatomical parts derived from animals
options.cecua_commercial: Commercially sourced biological samples from animals
options.bio_reagents: Use of chemical reagents, drugs, hormones, radioisotopes
options.bio_human: Use of biological samples from people
options.bio_animal: Use of biological samples from animals
options.bio_cell_generated: Generation of cell lines from animal or human samples
options.bio_agents: Use and/or generation of biological agents (such as bacteria, viruses, fungi, parasites, infectious material, genetically modified organisms)
options.bio_env_samples: Manipulation of the natural environment: collection and use of environmental samples
options.bio_env_apply: Manipulation of the natural environment: application of external elements to the environment
